program.name: CSA Volleyball
program.motto: Build skills. Build confidence. Have fun.

divisions.name: Beginner
divisions.label: 1st–2nd grade
divisions.focus: Introduction to movement, ball control, underhand serve
goals: Make a proper passing platform (arms together, thumbs parallel)
Underhand serve from the 10-foot line with reasonable consistency
Call “mine” before playing the ball
Rotate clockwise when their team earns the serve
Demonstrate basic sportsmanship (handshake line, cheering for teammates)

divisions.name: Developmental
divisions.label: 3rd grade
divisions.focus: Passing, setting, serving progression, team concepts
goals: Pass with a consistent, locked platform, directing the ball toward the setter
Underhand serve from 15 feet; attempt overhand serve from 10 feet
Understand and attempt the Pass–Set–Hit sequence
Rotate correctly and understand their court position number
Open up and face the passer (“belly button to the ball”)
Hit a downball over the net from behind the 10-foot line
Communicate with teammates during play

divisions.name: Developmental
divisions.label: 4th grade
divisions.focus: Passing, setting, serving progression, team concepts
goals: Pass with a consistent, locked platform, directing the ball toward the setter
Underhand serve from 15 feet; attempt overhand serve from 10 feet
Understand and attempt the Pass–Set–Hit sequence
Rotate correctly and understand their court position number
Open up and face the passer (“belly button to the ball”)
Hit a downball over the net from behind the 10-foot line
Communicate with teammates during play

divisions.name: Intermediate
divisions.label: 5th–6th grade
divisions.focus: Full game play, overhand serve, pass-set-hit system
goals: Pass consistently to a target (setter position)
Overhand serve from the end line with reasonable accuracy
Execute a basic overhead set to a hitter
Run a 3-step approach and contact a set ball
Understand serve receive formation (“W” formation)
Play in a base defensive position
Execute the full Pass–Set–Hit sequence in game situations

1.label: 1st grade
1.note: Each player serves up to three in a row, and the serve rotates on a side-out.
1.skills: make a passing platform, serve underhand, call the ball, rotate, and cheer for her teammates.

2.label: 2nd grade
2.note: Each player serves up to three in a row, and the serve rotates on a side-out.
2.skills: make a passing platform, serve underhand, call the ball, rotate, and cheer for her teammates.

3.label: 3rd grade
3.serve: Underhand from 15 ft, or overhand from 10 ft
3.note: She chooses underhand or overhand. Coaches encourage overhand attempts.
3.skills: pass to a target, move up the serve progression, run pass–set–hit, hit a downball, and talk on the court.

4.label: 4th grade
4.note: Coaches start pushing toward the overhand serve from 22 feet.
4.skills: pass to a target, move up the serve progression, run pass–set–hit, hit a downball, and talk on the court.

5.label: 5th grade
5.serve: Underhand or overhand, from the end line
5.note: A server can score at most five points in a row before the serve changes.
5.skills: pass consistently, serve overhand from the end line, set overhead, use a three-step approach, and receive serve in a W formation.

6.label: 6th grade
6.serve: Underhand or overhand, from the end line
6.note: A server can score at most five points in a row before the serve changes.
6.skills: pass consistently, serve overhand from the end line, set overhead, use a three-step approach, and receive serve in a W formation.
